courses.title: Fire in the Eyes: The Eyeshine of the Totem Shapeshifter Intensive
courses.description: An in-person afternoon intensive with Irma on meeting one's totem animal and nature guides in the Indigenous medicine way: fire reading, journeying, shapeshifting through movement, gazing and tracking energy, and recapitulation to release and restore one's energy. Hosted by Recuerdo Wellness; bring a blindfold, candles, a small altar and a journal.

courses.title: Candle Fire Readings and Online Healings
courses.description: One-to-one sessions with Irma, currently online only: candle-fire and crystal readings about ancestry, guides and allies, and shamanic healings such as soul retrieval, past-life regression, Vogel wand and Chumpi stone work, cord cutting, Karuna Reiki and distance healing for relatives. She also offers one-to-one classes on a subject of the client's choosing.

left_out: In-person healings, egg limpias and plant-medicine limpias: marked 'Currently not available' on the page; not described in the item.
